entities.name: Ignis, Molten Behemoth
entities.summary: Summoned a massive subterranean magma boss named Ignis, Molten Behemoth, tuned to 800 HP with high-impact charging attacks, molten ember visuals, and a massive physical scale.

entities.name: Vulkar, the Hearthbreaker
entities.summary: An 800-HP magma behemoth inheriting BaseGroundBoss physics and behavior. Its charging magma beam uses a telegraphed ProjectileBurst, complemented by lunging charges. At 2.5x scale, its 80x64 reference bounds become a matching 200x160 collider and hitbox. Intended placement is outside the player's base in the Verdant frontier; near-base spawning requires encounter-spawner configuration because this schema has no spawn-location field.

entities.name: Briarsteel, the Tenblade Warden
entities.summary: Briarsteel, the Tenblade Warden, inherits stable ground-boss physics and pairs two five-sword ProjectileBurst modules for ten swords per attack cycle. Low per-sword damage and a 1.4-second warning keep the encounter manageable near spawn. Intended placement: a Verdant frontier clearing approximately 600 world units from spawn, at least 300 units outside the base perimeter. Intended sword behavior: home toward the player during initial flight, then stop tracking so they can be dodged. Homing, sword-shaped projectiles, and spawn exclusion distances require runtime configuration beyond this schema; they are design requirements, not encoded capabilities.

entities.name: Briarsteel, the Orbiting Duelist
entities.summary: Adds a level-30 boss with six swords visibly orbiting its body. MeleeSwipe represents a telegraphed sweep of the orbiting blades; ProjectileBurst launches three sword-shaped projectiles, animated point-first toward the player. Each launched sword should continuously follow the player until its first collision with the player or a solid block, then disappear; blocks intercept swords without taking player-directed damage. Use limited turning speed so players can steer pursuing blades into terrain. Inherits stable ground physics and preserves the base mass and controller. Sword-shaped projectile rendering and persistent homing require a ProjectileBurst ability extension because this schema does not expose those settings directly.
